title: feat(client): meta.publishItem names the package whose draft it promotes, sent as ?package=
body:
Fixes #23658
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What this does

`client.meta.publishItem(type, name, opts?)` takes `opts.packageId?: string`, sent as `?package=ID` on `POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/publish`.
- Only a non-empty id reaches the wire: `undefined` and `''` send no `package` key. This is `metaSaveQuery`'s guard, with `URLSearchParams.set` (never `append`, because the door refuses a repeated `?package=`).
- `message` still rides the body, unchanged. An options-less publish sends byte-identical requests to before.
- The docblock names the option and the two refusals that prescribe it, in the form `deleteItem`'s does.
- Changeset `.changeset/23658-client-publish-package.md`: `@objectstack/client` `minor`, `feat(client):`, in #23293's house form.

## Why

Since PR #23654 (`57994c311f`), a per-item publish that names no package is refused with a `?package=` remedy, and nothing is published:
- `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` for an item two or more packages hold;
- `404 NO_DRAFT` when the item's one package holds no draft and another package's draft is stored.

The SDK could not send the remedy. This is the publish half of what #23293 did for `deleteItem`.

## Measured first: the two mechanism hypotheses

**(a) One declaration: holds.** `publishItem` is declared once, on the unscoped `ObjectStackClient.meta` (`index.ts`, the `meta` object at `:1812`). The environment-scoped `client.environment(id).meta` (`:7698` on the base) declares `getTypes`, `getItems`, `getItem`, `saveItem`, `deleteItem` and `getHistory`, and no `publishItem`. No method is added there. A wire row pins the absence, with `deleteItem` on the same object as its positive control.

**(b) The doors read `?package=`: the REST door does, and the dispatcher serves no per-item publish door.**
- **REST:** the publish handler reads it through `metaItemPackageBinding(req.query?.package)` (the save and delete doors' function) and spreads `packageId` into `publishMetaItem`'s request. The real-door rows below drive this door.
- **Dispatcher** (the `createHonoApp` catch-all): measured on the runtime `dist/` built at `57994c311f`. `HttpDispatcher.handleMetadata('/view/x/publish', ctx, 'POST', {}, { package: 'pkg' })` answers `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` (`Route Not Found: /meta/view/x/publish`), and the spy `publishMetaItem` is called 0 times.
  - Control on the same instrument: `PUT /view/x?package=pkg` answers 200, and `saveMetaItem` receives `packageId: "pkg"`.
  - `createMetaDomain`'s handler and `handleMetadata` both call `handleMetadataRequest`, so this is the body the catch-all reaches past its gates.
  - The per-item publish is a `RestServer`-owned route (`rest-route-ledger.ts`, `source: 'route-manager'`), and the runtime route ledger has no row for it. So the `?package=` forwarding question does not arise on the dispatcher. See Acceptance notes.
  - NOT MEASURED: the full `dispatch()` leg. My probe got `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` there even with identity stubbed, and the `PUT` control got the same 401, so that leg never reached the domain.

## Pins: `packages/client/src/meta-publish-item-package.test.ts` (new file)

A new file rather than beside the twin. The twin's real-door rig is local to `meta-delete-item-carriers.test.ts`, and importing it from that test file would register every suite of that file a second time. A helper module under `src/` would sit in the build program, which excludes only `*.test.ts`. So the rig is copied here, narrowed to the publish door. It imports exactly the workspace packages the twin imports, so `check:test-source-alias`'s `@objectstack/client` row is unchanged.

**Wire rows** (a fake `fetch`):
- `packageId: 'pkg'` sends `?package=pkg` on the publish URL, and the body names no package;
- `undefined`, `''`, `{}` and no options send no query;
- `message` still rides the body, with and without a package, and the key is sent once;
- an id that needs encoding is encoded byte-identically to `saveItem` and `deleteItem`;
- the scoped `meta` declares no `publishItem`.

**The real door** (`RestServer` over the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` on `SqliteWasmDriver`, the twin's rig; the only stub is the auth boundary; rows read straight out of `sys_metadata` as `package:state:label`):
- **Two packages, naming none:** active rows in `com.qa.alpha` and `com.qa.beta`, plus a pending `com.qa.alpha` draft. Refused `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` / 409, the rows are unchanged, and no `packageId` reached the protocol.
- **Two packages, naming one:** the same item with `{ packageId: 'com.qa.alpha', message }` succeeds. `com.qa.alpha`'s draft is now its active row, `com.qa.beta`'s row is untouched, and the protocol received `packageId` and `message`.
- **The only draft is another package's:** an item bound to `com.qa.alpha` whose only draft is `com.qa.beta`'s. Naming none is refused `NO_DRAFT` / 404 and the rows are unchanged; `{ packageId: 'com.qa.beta' }` succeeds, and that draft becomes `com.qa.beta`'s active row.

## Ablation (one-shot, at `0405b4f4cd`)

- **Mutation:** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the `params.set('package', …)` line with a marker. On-disk proof: anchor 1 to 0; marker 0 to 1; set-line count 2 to 1 (`getDiagnostics` keeps its own); blob `6fcd25d` to `c5a8538`.
- **Traps:** the tool's own restore trap, plus an outer `trap … EXIT INT TERM` that restores from `HEAD` on an absolute path.
- **No rebuild leg:** the test imports the client from `./index` (source), not through `exports`.
- **Direction declared before the run:** 5 red, 3 green. **Observed:** 5 failed, 3 passed.
  - Red: the `?package=` wire row; the `message` row (`expected '' to be '?package=com.qa.alpha'`); the encoding row; two packages naming one (refused `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` / 409 by the door); the NO_DRAFT row (refused `NO_DRAFT` / 404).
  - Green: the negative control, the scoped absence, and two packages naming none.
- **Restore:** proven by the tool and again by the outer trap. The blob is back to `6fcd25d`, equal to HEAD's; `git diff HEAD` and porcelain are empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **The dispatcher serves no per-item publish door.** On a host that serves only `createHonoApp`'s dispatcher catch-all, without `RestServer`, `client.meta.publishItem` answers `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` whatever the package. The runtime route ledger has no `DELETE /meta/:type/:name` row either, so `deleteItem` lands on the same tail.
  - It is a located refusal on a transport that does not own the route: route rule 1, one route one owner; rule 3, absence is loud.
  - Not filed: no contract says the dispatcher serves it. Carrier: none.
- **The rig is a copy.** The real-door rig here is a copy of the delete twin's (about 90 lines), for the reason under Pins.
- **Refusal prose is not pinned.** The real-door rows assert the refusals' `code` and status, the stored rows and the protocol probe, not the door's sentences, because no consumer parses that prose.
